comments.author: reviewer
comments.body: This drops the original query string. Keep `next` when you rebuild the URL.

linear.issue/WEB-412.title: Login redirects forever after session expiry
linear.issue/WEB-412.description: After the session cookie expires, /dashboard sends the person to /login?next=/dashboard, and /login sends them straight back because it reads a stale cookie.

diffs.src/auth/redirect.ts:
@@ -15,6 +15,9 @@
-  return new URL('/login', base)
+  const url = new URL('/login', base)
+  if (expired(session)) clearCookie(res)
+  return url

memories.auth-cookie-name: The session cookie is `wa_session`; tests stub it through `testCookies()`.

notes.task: Repro: expire the cookie in devtools, then load /dashboard.
